_about: Reasons to come back (GameSession+Rewards.swift). `dailyGifts`: one a calendar day, the next in the round each day you play (missing a day costs nothing), gold as `goldPerLevel` × your level. `bounties`: `perDay` tasks a day, each kind's count rolled in [low, high] (defeatOnMap: monsters on a land you've been to that suits your level; defeatElement: monsters of an element found there; wins: fights won; rare: rare monsters; seal: monsters sealed), each paying `exp` × the EXP your level needs and `goldPerLevel` × your level, and the `bonus` once all are claimed. `quests`: the least a quest pays when you hand it in, for your level then: `exp` × the EXP your level needs and `goldPerLevel` × your level, a bit more than a bounty (its own gold and EXP when they're higher; a quest that pays no gold or no EXP still pays none). `bookMilestones`: paid once each when the Monster Book reaches `count` kinds of monster (no count: every one).
